{{Quote|A tree grows in the close wastes, drinking deeply from this planet's corruption. Its roots cradle memories of our ancient enemy. Place the dark ones in the Cave-Under-Tree's embrace. Soon their energy will fuel our escape.|Heart Rend|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Cave-Under-Tree''' was the name given by the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to a subterranean facility built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] underneath a massive [[Zedalus Tree]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. When the Esh-kha were released from their imprisonment during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], they captured the powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]], and they moved the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to the Cave-Under-Tree. There, the Esh-kha [[Heart Rend]] and his [[Esh-kha savant|savants]] sought to harness the Dread Masters' power, but were defeated by Imperial forces that freed the Dread Masters.

==Behind the scenes==
Cave-Under-Tree appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Imperial mission "Terror in the Flesh."<ref name="TOR" />
